plan.title: The business's plan
plan.leadFree: Everything is free during the launch period.
plan.leadOn: The Business plan is active for your business.
plan.leadFreeTier: Your business is on the permanent free tier.
plan.freeBody: Listings, enquiries, client occasions, the library, branding on guest pages and reports are included, with no card and no trial. There is nothing for you to activate.
plan.noticeTitle: From {date}, some features become optional paid tiers
plan.noticeBody: Nothing changes until then. After that date, anyone who buys nothing stays on the permanent free tier described below. Nothing is charged automatically.
plan.freeTierBody: Whatever changes later, these stay with your business at no cost.

freeTier.account: The business account and its team.
freeTier.listing: Existing listings stay public and can be corrected.
freeTier.enquiries: You receive enquiries and answer them.
freeTier.assets: Floor plans and catalogues already published and files already shared stay readable.
freeTier.existingOccasions: Client occasions that already exist stay fully usable, for the whole team.
freeTier.handover: You can hand an occasion over to the client at any time.

plan.promiseTitle: What we promise if a paid plan ever appears
plan.promise1: We tell you at least 60 days ahead, here and by email, and remind you 30 and 7 days before.
plan.promise2: Nothing is charged automatically. We never ask for a card in advance.
plan.promise3: Your clients' occasions are never blocked, whatever plan you have.
plan.laterBody: If there is ever a paid plan, it will cover only creating new client occasions, branding changes, library edits and new listings. The order of directory results is not for sale.

paid.returnedTitle: You are back from the payment page
paid.returnedBody: The plan becomes active when we receive the payment processor's confirmation. It usually takes under a minute; reload the page.
paid.exclTva: Prices exclude VAT (TVA). The VAT and the total are shown separately.
paid.noTva: The operator is not VAT-registered: no VAT is added.

plans.featuredMonthly: Featured, per listing and category, per month

paid.stops: Without the Business plan only these stop: new client occasions, branding changes, library edits and new listings. Everything that exists stays.
paid.graceUntil: The payment did not go through. The plan stays active until {date}.
paid.cancel: Stop at the end of the period
paid.cancelRequested: Request sent. The plan stays active until the end of the paid period.
paid.buyBody: You pay on the payment processor's page, with Apple Pay, Google Pay or a card. For each payment you receive a fiscal invoice with the VAT shown.
paid.notConfigured: Payment is not available yet. Come back later.
paid.featuredBody: Featured means a place above the ordinary results, with the label “Featured — paid placement”. On every search at most three featured listings are picked at random. The order of the ordinary results does not change.
paid.featuredNoListing: You need a public listing to buy a placement.
paid.featuredNoGuarantee: The figures are an estimate, with no guarantee: the number of views is not promised.

console.title: Commercial
console.description: The cost of the free phase, the monetization switch and billing in test mode. Every change that matters needs a second person.
console.requested: The request is waiting for a second person.
console.reasonHint: It stays in the audit log. At least 10 characters.

cost.title: Free phase
cost.perMonth: per month, entered by the operator
cost.placeholder: placeholder value — enter the real cost below
cost.breakEven: At the current prices, the monthly cost would be covered by {plans} monthly Business plans.
cost.breakEvenPlaceholder: At the pilot prices, not yet confirmed, the monthly cost would be covered by {plans} monthly Business plans.
cost.amountHint: Digits only, no thousands separator. Example: 18500 or 18500,50.

switch.title: The monetization switch

about.off: Everything is free. There are no prices, payment or card anywhere in the product, and Featured does not exist.
about.notice: Businesses have been told. Until the effective date nothing changes for them.
about.on: The Business plan and Featured can be bought. Businesses without a plan are on the permanent free tier.

switch.enableBody: Turning it on needs a platform admin's approval. On approval the {days}-day public notice starts; paid plans take effect only at its end.
switch.disableBody: Turning it off makes everything free again for every business. It needs a platform admin's approval.
switch.singleOperator: Only one person holds a console role. Turning it on and real payments need a second person.
switch.needsAcceptance: The test-mode billing acceptance is missing. Record it alongside.
switch.requesterOnly: The request can be made by a commercial manager.

acceptance.title: Billing acceptance in test mode
acceptance.body: Before turning it on, billing must be checked end to end in test mode: payment, signed confirmation, grace, cancellation, refund, fiscal invoice with VAT.
acceptance.evidenceHint: The run report, ticket or document.

history.title: Switch history
history.empty: The switch has never been changed.

processor.title: Payment processor
processor.body: Keys go in the server configuration, not here. Without them every payment attempt is politely refused.

sandbox.title: Test run
sandbox.body: Opens a payment in the processor's test mode, for the acceptance. Nothing is charged and the business receives nothing.
sandbox.businessHint: You find it in the address of the business's console page.
sandbox.featuredByHand: For Featured, add a test placement below.
sandbox.unavailable: A test run needs a configured test key.

subs.title: Subscriptions
subs.offNote: While monetization is off, only subscriptions from test runs appear here. They change nothing for businesses.

refunds.title: Refunds and credits
refunds.requestTitle: Request a refund or a credit

featured.title: Featured placements
featured.body: At most three, picked at random on every search, above the ordinary results and with the label “Featured — paid placement”.
featured.listingIdHint: You find it in the address of the listing's page.

prices.title: Prices
prices.body: Prices exclude VAT. A change is a request that a second person approves.
prices.placeholder: The prices shown are the pilot ones, not yet confirmed by the operator.
prices.businessMonthly: Business plan per month, in RON excl. VAT
prices.businessYearly: Business plan per year, in RON excl. VAT
prices.featuredMonthly: Featured per month, in RON excl. VAT
prices.tvaHint: Enter 0 if the operator is not VAT-registered.

approvals.enable: Turn monetization on, with a {days}-day public notice
approvals.disable: Turn monetization off: everything becomes free again
approvals.prices: New prices excl. VAT: {monthly} RON per month, {yearly} RON per year, Featured {featured} RON; VAT {tva}%

email.subject: EventDesk: what changes for businesses from {date}
email.intro60: Hello, {business}. From {date}, the Business plan and Featured placement become optional paid tiers. Nothing changes until then.
email.intro30: Hello, {business}. A reminder: from {date}, the Business plan and Featured placement become optional paid tiers.
email.intro7: Hello, {business}. In a week, from {date}, the Business plan and Featured placement become optional paid tiers.
email.keep: If you do nothing, your business stays on the permanent free tier: account, listings, enquiries, files already published and your own statistics. Client occasions that already exist stay fully usable.
email.nothingAutomatic: Nothing is charged automatically and we do not ask for a card.

errors.acceptanceMissing: Record the test-mode billing acceptance first.
errors.singleOperator: A second person with a console role is needed.
errors.reasonRequired: Write the reason, at least 10 characters.
errors.processor: The payment processor did not answer as expected. Try again.
errors.sandboxNeedsTestKey: A test run only works with a test key.
errors.signature: The signature could not be verified.
errors.amount: Write the amount in digits only, for example 18500 or 199,50.
errors.percent: Write the rate in percent, for example 21.
